title: Technology Sector Update for 05/08/2018: VECO,XCRA,COHU,JD

Technology stocks were drifting lower Tuesday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 losing less than 0.2% although the Philadelphia semiconductor index was posting a nearly 0.2% advance.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Veeco Instruments ( VECO ) jumped more than 14% on Tuesday after the electronic components company beat analyst estimates with its Q1 net income and revenue. Excluding one-time items, it earned $0.20 per share during the January-to-March fiscal period, almost doubling its $0.11 per share non-GAAP profit last year and easily beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.14 per share. Revenue increased to $158.6 million from $94.5 million last year and also exceeding the $151.62 million Street view. For the current quarter, Veeco is expecting non-GAAP earnings in a range of $0.01 to $0.20 per share on between $145 million to $170 million in revenue. Analysts are expecting adjusted Q2 net income of $0.13 per share on $158 million in revenue.
In other sector news:
- Excerra Corp ( XCRA ) raced to an 11-year high on Tuesday, topping out at its best share price since July 2007 at $13.62 apiece after the firm agreed to a $796 million buyout from Cohu Inc ( COHU ). Under terms of the stock-and-cash deal, Excerra investors will receive $9.00 in cash and 0.2109 of a Cohu common share for each share they now own, valuing the target company at $13.92 a share. Cohu said it expects the transaction will immediately add to its adjusted per-share earnings after closing, expected during the second half of 2018.
- JD.com ( JD ) dropped almost 5% on Tuesday after the Chinese e-commerce company reported Q1 net income trailing Wall Street expectations despite a larger-than-expected 33% increase in revenue for the January-to-March quarter. Excluding one-time items, the company earned RMB0.71 per American depository share compared with RMB0.92 per ADS during the same quarter last year and lagging the Capital IQ consensus by RMB0.11 per ADS. It also generated RMB100.1 billion in revenue during the quarter, topping the $98.92 billion analyst mean.
